name: Smokehouse USDC
oneLiner: bbqUSDC is Steakhouse's high-yield MetaMorpho USDC vault; share price accrues borrower interest across wider-risk Morpho markets.
collateral: USDC deposited into Steakhouse's Smokehouse MetaMorpho vault, allocated across Morpho Blue lending markets that intentionally include wider and more exotic borrower collateral than Steakhouse's Prime line
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 MetaMorpho vault shares appreciate against USDC as borrower interest accrues; withdrawals redeem shares for available USDC liquidity or wait for Morpho market liquidity to return

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: Pharos Safety Score R1 vault parity review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact Ethereum Smokehouse V1 receipt 0xbeefff209270748ddd194831b3fa287a5386f5bc is an immutable MetaMorpho ERC-4626 lending position, not direct fiat cash or the separate Smokehouse V2 product. Content as of 2026-10-20: C13 rechecked the exact vault and V1 contract documentation. Shares claim residual USDC-denominated lending NAV with borrower-credit, collateral and liquidity risk; fee-share accrual does not establish independent financial assurance. This sourced departure from the USDC parent establishes protocol-position identity without legal custody/repledging rights, segregation, full-book stressed liquidity or funded default recovery.
